achoo.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one sneezes.

basis.englishDescription: A basis that comprises a certain thing or phenomenon.
The part that forms the base of an object.

basis.definitionKo: 무엇을 평가하거나 결정할 때 기준이 되는 생각이나 사실.
basis.englishDescription: A thought or fact that serves as a standard for evaluating or deciding something.

basis.definitionKo: 무엇을 하기 위해서 기초가 되는 바탕.
(비유적으로) 어떤 일을 이루는 데 있어 작은 바탕이 되는 것.
basis.englishDescription: (figurative) A small thing that serves as a basis for accomplishing a certain task.

basis.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 이루는 데 기초가 되는 요소.
basis.englishDescription: An element that serves as a foundation for accomplishing something.
(figurative) A thing that serves as a foundation for a certain task or phenomenon to be realized.
(figurative) A basis or foundation for a certain object or phenomenon.

basis.definitionKo: 구별하거나 정도를 판단하기 위해 그것과 비교하도록 정한 대상이나 잣대.
basis.englishDescription: The comparison items or measurement criteria used to tell or grade something.

bylaws.definitionKo: 중심이나 기본이 되는 규칙을 다시 나누어 자세하게 만든 규칙.
bylaws.englishDescription: Detailed rules made by subdividing the main or basic rules.

dolphin.definitionKo: 작은 이빨이 있고 주둥이가 가늘고 길며 머리가 좋아 기르며 훈련을 시키기도 하는 작은 고래.
dolphin.englishDescription: A small whale with small teeth, a long, narrow snout, often raised and trained by people because it is a highly intelligent animal.

giggle.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when someone suppresses his/her laugh.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참으면서 입속으로만 웃는 소리를 계속 내다.
giggle.englishDescription: To constantly make laughing sounds only inside one's mouth while holding back one's laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참으면서 입속으로만 웃는 소리를 계속 내다.
giggle.englishDescription: To constantly make laughing sounds only inside one's mouth while holding back one's laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 입속에서 새어 나오는 소리로 자꾸 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: To make stifled laughing sounds repeatedly at the corner of one's mouth, after failing to hold back one's laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 자꾸 입속으로 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: To make stifled laughing sounds repeatedly, after failing to hold back one’s laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참으면서 입속으로만 웃는 소리가 나다.
giggle.englishDescription: To make laughing sounds only inside one's mouth while holding back one's laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 주로 여자나 아이들이 빠르게 잇따라 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: For mainly females or children to laugh with repeated short, spasmodic sounds.

giggle.definitionKo: 주로 여자나 아이들이 빠르게 잇따라 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: For mainly females or children to laugh with repeated short, spasmodic sounds.
For mainly females or children to laugh with short, spasmodic sounds.
For mainly young children to laugh with repeated short, spasmodic sounds.
For mainly young children to laugh with repeated short, spasmodic sounds.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 입속에서 새어 나오는 소리로 자꾸 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: To make stifled laughing sounds repeatedly at the corner of one's mouth, after failing to hold back one's laughter.

giggle.definitionKo: 웃음을 참지 못하여 입속에서 자꾸 새어 나오는 소리로 웃다.
giggle.englishDescription: To make stifled laughing sounds repeatedly at the corner of one's mouth, after failing to hold back one's laughter.

giggle.englishDescription: To make stifled laughing sounds at the corner of one's mouth, after failing to hold back one's laughter.

investor.definitionKo: 사업이나 장사를 하는 데 바탕이 되는 돈이나 물건 등을 대는 사람.
investor.englishDescription: A person who provides money, supplies, etc., needed to run a business or establishment.

investor.definitionKo: 이익을 얻기 위해 어떤 일이나 사업에 돈을 대거나 시간이나 정성을 쏟는 사람.
investor.englishDescription: A person who spends money, time, or energy in a certain project or business, to gain a profit.

investor.definitionKo: 이익을 얻기 위해 어떤 일이나 사업에 돈을 대거나 시간이나 정성을 쏟는 사람.
investor.englishDescription: A person who spends money, time, or energy in a certain project or business, to gain a profit.

irang.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 함께 하는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
irang.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate the subject one is doing something with.

irang.definitionKo: 비교의 대상이거나 기준으로 삼는 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
irang.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to indicate that something is being compared or used as a criterion for comparison.

irang.definitionKo: 앞과 뒤의 명사를 같은 자격으로 이어주는 조사.
irang.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to connect the preceding and following nouns.

irang.definitionKo: 누군가를 상대로 하여 어떤 일을 할 때 그 상대임을 나타내는 조사.
irang.englishDescription: A postpositional particle that indicates the person whom one is doing something with.

irregularity.definitionKo: 규칙에서 벗어나 달라짐. 또는 그런 규칙.
irregularity.englishDescription: A state in which something is against the rule, or an irregular rule.

irregularity.definitionKo: 도리에 어긋나거나 이치에 맞지 않음. 또는 그런 일.
irregularity.englishDescription: A state of being against reason or justice; such behavior.

irregularity.definitionKo: 규칙에서 벗어나 있음. 또는 규칙이 없음.
irregularity.englishDescription: A state of deviating from a rule or having no rules.
An act that is not morally right.

irregularity.definitionKo: 일정한 규칙에서 벗어나는 성질. 또는 규칙이 없는 성질.
irregularity.englishDescription: The quality of being against a certain rule; the quality of having no rules.

jeans.englishDescription: A pair of blue pants made of strong cotton.

luminous.definitionKo: 어두운 곳에 밝은 빛이 비치어 조금 환하다.
luminous.englishDescription: Slightly bright as a light shines in darkness.
The light emanating from something being bright.

shipwreck.definitionKo: 배가 폭풍우나 암초 등을 만나 부서지거나 뒤집힘.
shipwreck.englishDescription: A disaster during a storm in which a ship sinks or breaks up against rocks.
The experience of encountering a disaster while on a voyage or hiking trip.
The act of a ship coming to be laid on a rock.

stubby.definitionKo: 짧게 베어서 뭉쳐 놓은 것처럼 짤막하다.
stubby.englishDescription: Looking short as if it were a stump left after being cut.
Thick and short with obtuse ends instead of being pointed.
Thick and short with its point being not sharp.

stubby.definitionKo: 끊어서 한 덩어리가 된 것처럼 조금 짧은 듯하다.
stubby.englishDescription: Looking short as if it were a stump left after being cut.

sweetener.englishDescription: An ingredient used to produce a sweet flavor.

volition.definitionKo: 무엇을 하고자 하는 적극적인 마음이나 의지.
volition.englishDescription: One's positive mind or will to do something.

warm.definitionKo: 날씨나 햇볕이 기분 좋을 만큼 따뜻하다.
warm.englishDescription: A weather or sunlight being pleasingly warm.
A facial expression or state of mind being tender.
In such a manner that something is quite warm and hot.

warm.definitionKo: 아주 덥지 않고 기분 좋은 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: Being an appropriate, pleasant temperature, which is not too high.

warm.definitionKo: 아주 덥지 않고 기분 좋은 정도로 알맞게 높은 온도로.
warm.englishDescription: In an appropriately high temperature that is pleasing, not too hot.

warm.definitionKo: 뜨겁지 않을 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: A temperature being not hot but appropriately high.

warm.definitionKo: 뜨겁지 않을 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: A temperature being not hot but appropriately high.

warm.definitionKo: 아주 덥지 않고 기분이 좋은 정도로 온도가 알맞게 높다.
warm.englishDescription: Being an appropriate, pleasant temperature, which is not too high.
(figurative) Intense and strong in feeling, passion, etc.

warm.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 아끼고 위하는 마음이 진실하고 지극하다.
warm.englishDescription: One's mind of treating someone kindly being sincere and faithful.

warm.definitionKo: 대하는 태도가 정성스럽고 마음을 다하여 애를 쓰는 데가 있다.
warm.englishDescription: One's attitude of treating someone being sincere and wholehearted.
Evoking feelings of warmth and closeness.
The weather being windless and quite warm.

warm.definitionKo: 마음을 부드럽게 해 주는 따뜻한 기운이 있다.
warm.englishDescription: Having warmth that softens the heart.

warm.definitionKo: 날씨나 온도가 견디기 좋을 만큼 따뜻하다.
warm.englishDescription: The weather or temperature being bearably warm.

warm.definitionKo: 마음을 부드럽게 녹여 주는 따뜻함이 있다.
warm.englishDescription: Having warmth that softens the heart.
